title: An Interactive and Helpful Program to Help Foreign Language Learners Learn New Languages through Videos
abstractFragment: An interactive, video-based language-learning application covering three languages, with a ten-page paper evaluating its design, methodology, and simulated learning results. Selected as one of three student speakers and one of nine student authors at ADNLP 2024; the paper was later selected for special-issue publication.
detail: Lead speaker · one of nine student authors

title: ForeignLanguagePro — Interactive Language Learning Application
abstractFragment: A U.S. patent covering the interactive language-learning application and its underlying natural-language-processing methods.

title: Tensor Decomposition for Chatbot Response Classification
abstractFragment: Applied tensor and CP decomposition to classify AI-generated responses from university chatbot interactions, evaluating contextual accuracy across student inquiry categories and identifying performance trends in information retrieval and response specificity.

title: Reward Modeling & Faithfulness Evaluation for LLM Systems
venue: William and Barbara Leonard Transportation Center
abstractFragment: Reward-modeling pipelines and evaluation frameworks for chatbot systems, measuring confidence calibration and faithfulness of LLM-generated outputs, with automated experiments assessing model truthfulness under varying prompts and conversational contexts.
